extra.message: Use of File.createTempFile without proper file permissions can lead to insecure temporary files. The patch introduces secure temporary file creation with restricted permissions (rw-------) on non-Windows systems. Replace direct calls to File.createTempFile() with the secure createTempFile() method that ensures proper file permissions.
